title: 56% Of The Ocean Changed Color In Twenty Years
hook: Satellites confirmed a global ocean shift that models warned about.
closing: The color shift is planet-sized evidence that ocean ecosystems are changing.
question: Have you noticed ocean color changing?

segments.say: About 56% of the ocean changed color over twenty years. The signal spans most of the planet's seas.
A model predicted 50% would change. Satellite observations then slightly exceeded that warning.
The changed ocean covers 203 million square kilometers. The warning became larger than all Earth's land.
